purpose.summary: Bound long regtest mining RPCs without changing the requested block totals, synchronization point, or legacy-compatibility oracles.
scope: Partition each mine_and_compare generation request into ordered calls of at most 50 blocks and require every call to return exactly the requested number of block hashes.
Keep requests of 1, 2, and 50 blocks as one RPC call; partition each 415-block pruning-boundary request into eight 50-block calls followed by one 15-block call.
Keep one synchronization and one full chain, UTXO, commitment, and raw-tip comparison after the complete requested block total.
Rebind the exact public change and preimage inventory while preserving the four canonical scenarios and all existing lifecycle, cleanup, identity, report, and privacy laws.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, or mainnet change.

No increase to the 60-second RPC timeout and no change to total blocks, miner roles, mining address, synchronization count, pruning boundary, scenario inventory, build roles, inherited-test selection, lifecycle oracles, report schema, or evidence status.
No incoming evidence, generated file, private source, private history, operator material, host metadata, or binary.

files.test_reachability: Exercises honest two-role coexistence, clean restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, one bounded default-protected valid-chain reorganization, and manual physical pruning.
Confines each functional cache to its disposable scenario root, prevents source bytecode writes, revalidates source identities, and runs the identity-bound fail-closed public matrix.
Covers per-scenario cache confinement, source immutability, runner contracts, reconstruction, lifecycle canaries, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public bounded-mining harness with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed legacy/candidate coexistence, restart, reconstruction, default-protected-reorganization, and physical-pruning scenario with its cache path confined below the scenario root.
expected_results: The existing lifecycle markers and exact chain, UTXO, raw-tip, reorganization, pruning, restart, and cross-mining oracles all pass without modifying either source tree.
failure_conditions: Any source mutation, cache escape, process, lifecycle marker, chain, UTXO, raw tip, restart, mining, cleanup, or identity divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the baseline daemon and a scenario-local cache.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip or source-tree writes under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any cache escape, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, source mutation, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the candidate daemon and a distinct scenario-local cache.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip or source-tree writes under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any cache alias, escape, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, source mutation, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged inherited feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path and a scenario-local cache.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-equivalent selection and no source-tree writes.
failure_conditions: Any cache escape, inherited-selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, or cleanup failure fails closed.

limitations: No public candidate execution evidence exists for ERGON-CHANGE-0014; any later successful public promotion remains capped at Observed / assembled_component.

The bounded-mining correction changes only the compatibility harness and its governance bindings; it does not change node behavior or strengthen any consensus, public-network, operator-binary, or mainnet claim.
The 50-block bound is a pragmatic RPC-liveness limit, not a consensus parameter, performance target, scaling result, or proof that every runner will complete within 60 seconds.
The closed ERGON-CHANGE-0013 diagnostic identifies the last completed lifecycle and last allowlisted feature frame but does not prove that one 415-block RPC caused the hosted failure.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality, and the dependency profile is not locked.
This initial record carries no execution evidence and is not an independent reproduction pack.
